title: May 14 EOD — Friday Theme: Second Tests. ATH week closes strong. China trip wraps, Dow 50K, S&P 7500.
macro: S&P crossed 7,500 first time. Dow retook 50,000. Nasdaq new record 26,635. Four consecutive ATH days. Trump-Xi summit: agreed Strait of Hormuz must reopen — no firm Iran commitments from China. Musk said talks were 'awesome'. Xi warned Taiwan mishandling could cause 'extremely dangerous situation'. NVDA +4% on H200 China approval — 10 firms cleared including Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance. Cerebras IPO opened $350 — NVDA rival, OpenAI and Amazon customers. Powell last day as Fed Chair Friday — Warsh confirmation expected. VIX 17.87. Consumer Sentiment 10am Friday. Oil $105 area — Hormuz agreement constructive but no ceasefire yet.
